channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ishmael Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ishmael Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan told B/R after Game 3.

“When Nikola says something, everybody's awareness is heightened. I always compare him to a guy like Tim Duncan. He's never really super boisterous, but when he does speak, it speaks volumes. Me, Jeff Green, DJ, Ish [Smith], KCP, we'll always give our two cents on things we see during the game, but Nikola saying something elevated the message. I've been on him more about being more vocal, and even in tonight's game, he was extremely vocal and it was good for our team.”

DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on Ishmael Smith
item.description:
“Before the game, I talked to Ish [Smith]. He told me ‘we’ve got nothing to lose, just ball out.’ He told me to just be aggressive tonight,”

Rui Hachimura on Ishmael Smith, Jun 1, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Ishmael Smith
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Ish Smith’s injury:

“It’s not great news, not at all. 6-8 weeks, that’s a big chunk of the season, but if anyone can handle it with a positive attitude, it’s Ish.”

Scott Brooks on Ishmael Smith, Feb 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.
